decisions.reason: The request for a revised BOM does not change the selected system design, CAD deliverable, or layout direction.
The source requests a revised BOM but does not change the wiring-plan deliverable or establish any new electrical-plan constraint.
Revising the BOM to reflect agreed changes does not itself alter the existing rapid-prototype priority or custom spout sourcing policy.
The revised-BOM request may document the already selected whisk, but it does not change any current whisk configuration requirement.
The revised-BOM request may document the agreed spout selection, but it does not modify the spout's geometry, orientation, construction, or quality constraints.
